title: Solo Farming In The Tower
altTitles: I'm the Only One Farming in the Dungeon
Only I Farm in the Dungeon
俺だけ塔で農家はじめました
description: A mysterious tower suddenly appears in the city, attracting people with its dangerous monsters and countless treasures. Sejun, an ordinary young man, enters the tower hoping to become rich but becomes trapped in a hidden area. With only a few seeds and his own body, he begins farming, gathering resources, completing quests, and slowly building a peaceful life alongside the tower's strange creatures.
author: Lim Hyeong
